missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Полк' is masculine nominative as the subject of 'вернулся'. 'Домой' is the directional adverb showing where it returned.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Полк' is the accusative object of 'поднял'; the inanimate masculine keeps the nominative form. 'Рано утром' gives the time.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В полку' uses the special locative ending '-у' after 'в'. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional, marking where he served.

missions.phrase: В деревне не было целого полка.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Полка' is the genitive after 'не было', and 'целого' agrees in the masculine genitive. 'В деревне' gives the place.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Из полка' takes the genitive after 'из' to show leaving the regiment. 'Несколько солдат' is the quantified subject.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'В полк' uses the accusative after 'в' to show enrolment into the regiment. 'Молодого офицера' is the animate accusative object.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К полку' uses the dative after 'к' to mean toward the regiment. 'Подкрепление' is the neuter nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Полком' is the instrumental required by 'гордился' to mean proud of the regiment. 'Своим' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Полки' is the nominative plural subject of 'шли'. 'Разные' agrees, and 'на параде' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Полков' is the genitive plural required after 'много'. 'В армии' is the prepositional location of the regiments.
